news_cards.title: Bihar Mein 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh: Steel, Textile Aur Nuclear Energy Sector Ko Milenge Naye Aavashyak
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga.
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko badhava milega, jisse rajya ki arthvyavastha ko majbooti milegi.
Yeh nivesh Bihar ko viksit desh ki ore le jane mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega, jisse rajya ki janata ko rozgar aur vikas ki nai sambhavnayein prapt hogi.
